name: ring-r1
cmd: GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|enum t|join (template|enumerated|end|failed)|^\[infer\] ' /tmp/err.log | grep -v 'diagram rows' | grep -v 'diagram view' | grep -v 'enum cube' | cut -c1-300 | head -c 14000; exit $s
